description: List the ElevenLabs voices available to this account (voice_id, name, category, labels, preview_url).
summary: List selectable ElevenLabs text-to-speech voices (the account's My Voices). Use a voice's `voice_id` as the 'voice_id' input of /text-to-speech. Free.

hints.speak with a voice: curl -X POST http://api.monid.ai/v1/run -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"provider":"elevenlabs","endpoint":"/text-to-speech","input":{"body":<BODY>,"queryParams":<QUERY_PARAMS>,"pathParams":<PATH_PARAMS>}}'  # pass the chosen voice_id in the body
